title: State awards $335,270 for safety work on Mississippi 336 in Pontotoc County
excerpt: Riverside Traffic Systems will install audible edge striping, reflective pavement markers and roadside signs between U.S. 278 and Apostolic Circle.
locality: Mississippi 336 between U.S. 278 and Apostolic Circle in Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Riverside Traffic Systems, Inc., of New Albany has won the $335,270 contract for safety improvements on Mississippi 336 between U.S. 278 and Apostolic Circle in Pontotoc County. The Mississippi Transportation Commission awarded the work Nov. 10, according to the state’s contract award report.

The plans call for 11 miles of audible striping along the road edges. The bid sheet also lists 1,140 raised reflective pavement markers, including 400 yellow markers and 740 clear ones. Those quantities count the markings to be installed along the route.
The state listed an estimate of $364,575.75 when it opened bids on Oct. 27. Riverside’s award is $29,305.75 below that figure. The bid also covers aluminum roadside signs and square-tube signposts.

Drivers looking for the work in MDOT records can find it under project 110210301. The award report identifies the contractor and the section of highway. It gives no construction start date or lane-closure schedule.
